design.stderr: broad patterns as before, plus 'hit your <word> limit' and 'session limit'
design.stdout: only short lines (at most 300 characters) that start with a CLI limit message: You've hit your [<word> ]limit, Claude AI usage limit reached, <n>-hour/session/weekly/usage limit reached
design.quota: at least one matching line and (non-zero exit, empty stdout, or a stdout made only of limit lines)
design.retryTime: unchanged parseRetryAfter (epoch suffix, 'resets 1:10am' local time, 'try again at')

cases: session limit on stdout with exit 1 (and its local reset time)
both streams, weekly limit, typographic apostrophe, epoch form
stdout made only of a limit line with exit 0
existing stderr forms (usage limit, 5-hour limit, rate limit)
negative: successful review quoting a limit message, the same review with exit 1, prose about a rate limit, unrelated git failure, plain success, an over-long line
